disambiguation: Not a simple search tool; it provides a visual, card-based interface for note organization and filtering.
extras: Supports English and Japanese interfaces; uses local IndexedDB for search cache; no external accounts or telemetry required.
problem: Users often struggle to visually browse and filter large sets of notes using complex criteria like Boolean logic or specific date ranges.
summary: A card view explorer that allows users to browse, filter, and organize notes using Google Keep-style cards, Boolean queries, and bulk actions.
